say.name: Rhea
say.text: Round one. You don't strike. You hold. Hold the wheel and take my blows. Then catch one at the very last moment.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: Good. A guard is a wall. A parry is a door you slam in their face.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: Round two. When I lift the blade high, the ground goes red. Don't block it. Go through it.

say.name: Rhea
say.text: You moved before you thought. Keep that. Last round: everything you have.
